name: Download to assets
description: Downloads files from the web into the frame's assets folder, for a gallery, the Files scene or a font to find. List the addresses in the scene's settings, one a line, or type one on the frame and tap Download; write "https://… -> name.ext" to pick a file's name. Files go into a folder of your choice (Downloads at first), a chunk at a time, so a big file works on an ESP32 too, with a progress line as it goes; a file already there is skipped, replaced or kept beside the new one, as you set. The folder's files are listed with their sizes, to delete with a confirm. Turn on "Download new addresses by themselves" for a frame without touch. On an ESP32 the server has to send files in parts (most file hosts do). The scene writes to the assets folder: installing it allows that. High contrast on black-and-white and grey panels, or always with the Contrast setting.
